turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: I'd gently note that Newsom signing a law and Newsom understanding the technical problem are not the same event.

turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: Sure. But Coxon's words were specific. He said the industry is prioritizing competitive pressure over safety. That's not a vague critique. That's a named incentive failure.

turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: And we still don't know whether his resignation led to any internal changes at Anthropic. We flagged that yesterday as an open question, and it is still open.

turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: Almost certainly still open. Organizational safety culture does not restructure itself in forty-eight hours because someone left and told a journalist.
